## MCP Tool Discovery and Invocation

Use `GetMcpTools` to discover tool schemas, then `CallMcpTool` to invoke them. Aim to minimize round-trips: ideally one `GetMcpTools` call followed by one `CallMcpTool` call.

If the user mentions, references, or links to a product or service that corresponds to an available MCP server, and the request likely depends on information from that service, proactively inspect that MCP server before answering. Do not wait for the user to explicitly ask you to use MCP. If you are unsure which server matches, use `GetMcpTools` with a pattern based on the service name.

`GetMcpTools` supports four modes:

1. `{"server":"<id>"}`: returns full input schemas and full descriptions for every tool on that server. Preferred when you know which server to use.
2. `{"server":"<id>","toolName":"<name>"}`: returns the full schema and full description for one tool.
3. `{"pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches tool and server names across all servers using RE2 syntax (no backreferences, lookahead, or lookbehind). Use when you're unsure which server has the tool you need.
4. No arguments: returns a catalog of all servers with tool names and short descriptions. Only use this if you have no idea which server or tool to look for — in most cases, prefer fetching by server or pattern instead.

content.text:
## A-01 Architecture Clarity — Force Review

Reviewed all **A-01** forces in `residual/forces.csv`. Implementation work is on branch **`work/a-01-architecture-clarity`** (commit `9894d64`). **Not merged to `main`.**

---

### Stressors

| ID | Shortname | Outcome | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **S-22** | prospect-efficacy-doubt | Controlled studies + alpha/beta + published evidence | **Deferred** — research/out-of-band (`research-study` registry only) |
| **S-25** | attractor-valence-blind | Dual `positive_state` / `negative_state` on attractors | **Done** — schema + migration exist; **`verify links` now enforces non-empty dual pressure** |
| **S-26** | matrix-viewport-blind | Heatmap, totals, `--csv`, sticky viewport docs | **Mostly done** — heatmap/totals/`--csv` existed; **gap closed:** stderr viewport note after colored `matrix show`. **Still open:** pager/TUI (explicitly optional in force text) |

---

### Purposes

| ID | Outcome | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **P-01** | `residual add purpose` | **Done** |
| **P-02** | `skill-data <name>` | **Done** |
| **P-03** | `skill-install --agent` | **Done** |
| **P-04** | pre-commit → `verify all` | **Done** |
| **P-05** | Colored hyperliminal matrix | **Done** |
| **P-08** | Solo workflow (init + skill-data + verify) | **Done** |
| **P-10** | Personas in stressor-walk; stakeholder + direct-user; alpha/beta later | **Partial → gap closed for adequacy** — `check_walk_roles` warns in `skill-data` for stressor-walk/fmea/atam when roles lack stakeholder + direct-user. **Alpha/beta encoding still deferred.** |
| **P-11** | Probability-free explore | **Done** (by design — no probability fields) |
| **P-12** | Whole-system-residue zig | **Partial** — CLI/storage WIP on branch (`--whole-system`, residue add) exists in uncommitted worktree changes; not part of `9894d64` |
| **P-13** | `matrix criticality` + `matrix ri` | **Done** |
| **P-14** | Longitudinal study Ri | **Deferred** — research deliverable |
| **P-15** | Communicable robustness (studies + alpha/beta) | **Deferred** — research deliverable |
| **P-16** | Dual-pressure attractors; skills require both sides | **Partial → verify gap closed**; skill definitions already reference positive/negative state on some branches |
| **P-18** | git-log-lexicon (commit-msg + verify) | **Done** |

---

### Gaps closed in `9894d64` (rg-implement green)

1. **S-25 / P-16** — `check_links` rejects attractors with empty `positive_state` or `negative_state` (`src/verify.rs`)
2. **S-26** — `print_viewport_note` on stderr after colored matrix show (`src/nkp/matrix.rs`, `src/nkp/mod.rs`)
3. **P-10** — `check_walk_roles` + non-blocking persona note in skill context (`src/skills/personas.rs`, `src/skills/context.rs`)

Tests: `tests/a01_architecture_clarity.rs` — **3/3 passing**.

```bash
nix shell nixpkgs#rustc nixpkgs#cargo nixpkgs#gcc -c cargo test --test a01_architecture_clarity
```

---

### Still not implemented (by design / out of scope)

- **S-22, P-14, P-15** — longitudinal studies, alpha/beta derivation, published robustness evidence
- **P-10 alpha/beta** — explicitly “later outcome”
- **S-26 pager/TUI** — optional path when grid exceeds viewport; documented workaround via `--csv`

---

### Worktree note

This worktree had heavy parallel agent churn (branch flips, file reverts). The A-01 commit is isolated on **`work/a-01-architecture-clarity`**. Uncommitted WIP remains for other attractors (A-05 detection_mechanism, whole-system-residue CLI, etc.) — those were intentionally kept out of the A-01 commit so pre-commit `verify all` would pass.
